# Joseph

- **Gender:** male (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P57](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0057)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Joseph is notable for wearing a coat of many colors. His distinctive, multicolored outerwear inspired his name.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056)_

## Personality

By nature, Joseph is meek, inoffensive, and possesses a sociable disposition. Although he is inherently pacific, he is capable of fighting well when the occasion arises.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P57](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0057), [v3 ch.Relationships P63](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0063)_

## History

Joseph is a cat with a multicolored coat who originally belonged to a dear friend of [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) before being given to her when his owner moved to [Vancouver](../codex/places.md#vancouver). He was brought to Patty's Place alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and the [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)-cat. After engaging in repeated battles with [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), a stray cat adopted by [Anne](../character/anne.md), Joseph eventually became Rusty's close friend. He later contributed to the household chaos at Patty's Place during an unexpected visit from [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) Gardner's mother and sisters.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P3](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0003), [v3 ch.Relationships P7](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0007), [v3 ch.Relationships P9](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0009), [v3 ch.Relationships P15](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0015), [v3 ch.Relationships P16](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0016), +159 more_

### [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--rusty.md)

[Rusty](../character/rusty.md) and Joseph are sworn friends who frequently sleep on the same cushion together at Patty's Place. Their relationship initially began with friction, as [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) engaged in repeated physical battles with Joseph upon the latter's arrival at the house. However, after these initial skirmishes, the two cats put aside their hostility and became close companions.

- Friend of — sworn friends who sleep on the same cushion (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)</sub>
